AN INTERACTIVE PEEK AT THE IDEA
QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Before your
first draft.

What to expect from the builder.

What could I make with Draftmango?+

A home for your business, a portfolio for your work, or a storefront for the things you make. Start with a simple idea and explore the style that fits it.

Do I need to be a designer?+

No. Start by describing your idea. You can guide the design through conversation, use the visual controls, or edit the source code yourself.

What if I don’t know where to start?+

That’s what first drafts are for. Try one of the idea buttons, explore an example, or hit “Surprise me.” A rough sentence is a perfectly good beginning.

What can I do in the builder today?+

The builder supports AI-assisted drafts, chat, source editing, browser previews and exports in enabled workspaces. Public access is being prepared. Paid plans, domain purchases and customer-site publishing are not live yet. See current availability.
